The '''Vesla Minor system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A system containing the planet Vesla first appeared in the potentially unlicensed adventure scenario: ''"[[Ship of Fools]]"'', from the [[1992]] magazine, [[Vortext 3|Vortext #3]]. This particular "Vesla system" featured in the appendix of [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. With the inclusion of the [[Vesla system/Legends|Vesla system]] in [[2011]]'s officially licensed [[The Old Republic — The Lost Suns 1|''The Old Republic—The Lost Suns 1'']], the system previously known as the "Vesla system" became the "Vesla Minor system" and was included in an update for [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion]].
